format: shell script with embedded C code
description: A shell script containing shared helper functions for diff algorithm tests, which includes embedded C code snippets for testing diff algorithms like patience and histogram. It defines test functions that generate C source files, perform diffs, and compare outputs.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Sets up C source files, performs diff operations, and verifies diff outputs for the 'frobnitz' and 'fib' functions.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Creates two text files with different contents, performs diff, and verifies the diff output.
